Ginger is a field crop unlocked at experience level 78.

It is used to make apple ginger tea, fish skewers, gingerbread cookie, peanut noodles, ginger essential oil and sesame brittle.

Like all crops, they are stored in the silo.

If you have none in your silo, you can buy 10 for 440 coin.

Growing ginger

Ginger is grown in fields by planting another ginger (either previously harvested or purchased). Each plot yields 2 plants (net gain of 1 plant) and 6 experience points, and takes 2 hours and 30 minutes to mature.

Selling ginger

  • Ginger can be sold or bought for a maximum price of 288 coin for 10 units.

Using ginger

Ginger is used to make the following products:


Sesame Brittle Ginger Essential Oil Peanut Noodles
x1 x5 x1
Level 78 Level 80 Level 86
Gingerbread Cookie Apple Ginger Tea Fish Skewer
x2 x1 x1
Level 86 Level 88 Level 96
Kimchi Zesty Perfume
x1 x3
Level 98 Level 113

Boat orders

  • Boat orders ask for 11 to 16 ginger per crate, up to a total of 52 per boat.

Strategy tips

  • Most recipes ask for 1 ginger. You want to make sure you always have enough of them in your silo.
